nodes.label: Compare Workbench
nodes.rationale: Expanding Compare opens a true 50/50 split (ADR-037): the wizard collapses, the live 3D viewport takes the left pane, the 2D orthographic drawing the right, and the four point drivers re-parent into a docked workbench rail. Built standalone in the topic's own architecture, NOT via engine config keys (Points is off engine.js, ADR-033); the single-WebGL-canvas invariant is kept because the right pane reuses the live 2D canvas. A remeasureAfterReflow waits a second frame so the renderer sizes to the true pane.

nodes.label: Fold Swoop
nodes.rationale: The step-5 fold swoops square-on to the orthographic answer sheet (ADR-036, overturning ADR-013's held-angle hold): driveFold forward calls swoopToAnswerSheet (engage ortho, glide front-on, morph perspective to ortho on easeFold) and reverse glides back via restorePerspective; the held-angle movers and the now-unused preFoldPose/FRAME_PADDING are deleted, so the perspective camera never moves during the fold.

nodes.label: Compare 2D Drawing
nodes.rationale: main.js drawCompare() live-repaints a plain 2D canvas from the point data every rebuild (never a snapshot): a FIXED scale keyed to the 40 mm slider max so 10 mm always reads as 10 mm, the lateral PP coordinate drawn as marks sliding off a centre datum, and paper-halo view marks per ADR-016; the projector is a solid Type-B thin line (only 3D pictorial projectors stay dashed).

nodes.label: Dual-Camera Ortho Quick-Views
nodes.rationale: A second OrthographicCamera + its own OrbitControls make the Top/Front/Side quick-views TRUE orthographic reads (RULES.md 5.18); a projectionMorphK matrix morph lerps the ortho projection from the perspective one and back so the hand-off gains/loses depth smoothly. Every camera-move seam hands the live camera back to perspective first so the two cameras never fight. The rogue single-camera ADR-035 was removed.

nodes.label: Ortho Orbit Lock
nodes.rationale: A quick-view / flat read is a square-on 2D view, so orthoControls.enableRotate is false (pan + zoom stay live); a left-drag on the locked ortho camera fires a qv-lock-cue shake + focus-ring nudge on the latched chip.

nodes.label: Points Quadrant Numeral Occlusion
nodes.rationale: labelLayer.updateOcclusion raycasts camera to each I-IV numeral against the sheet FILL meshes (Line2 grids excluded since their raycast needs Raycaster.camera) and hides any occluded numeral, so numerals no longer read through the HP/VP sheets; numerals were also pushed to the far grid corners to stop clashing with P/p/p'.

nodes.label: Points Problem Library
nodes.rationale: pointProblems.js ports the K.C. John / N.D. Bhatt textbook point problems in three tiers; problemLibrary.js is a data-driven +/-0.5 mm-tolerant OR-array self-check that never auto-fills (on-plane cases keep OR-array targets so a zero-distance point grades correct in either coincident quadrant, ADR-015), loading a problem resets to defaults and routes to Step 1 so the learner dials the answer by hand.

nodes.label: Points Pipeline Migration
nodes.rationale: The topic was cut from the Module 2 skeleton onto the orchestrator pattern (ADR-033): solid generators, shapeData.js, meshAnalyzer/projectionDrawer/vertexLabeler were stripped (a dimensionless point has no edges to weld) and pointData.js + the polished hvPlanes.js/point.js were ported verbatim from the Spatial Framework sibling.
